---

Hover over any topic to see its connections. Scroll to zoom, and click and drag to pan.

```{=html}
<style>
  .node {
    font: 14px sans-serif;
    fill: #555555;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: fill 0.2s, font-weight 0.1s ease;
  }
  .node:hover {
    font-weight: 900;
    fill: #000;
  }
  .link {
    stroke: #b0c4de; 
    stroke-opacity: 0.3;
    fill: none;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .node--connected {
    fill: #3f51b5 !important;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .link--connected {
    stroke: #3f51b5;
    stroke-opacity: 0.8;
    stroke-width: 2.5px;
  }
</style>

<div id="edge-bundling-container" style="display: flex; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 850px; margin-top: 20px; border: 1px solid #eaeaea; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden;"></div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7" data-external="1"></script>
<script>
window.addEventListener("load", function() {
    
  // Flattened data structure: No more dots/domains in the names
  const nodesData = [
    {id: "Causal Inference", imports: ["Causal Machine Learning", "HTE"]},
    {id: "Causal Machine Learning", imports: ["Regression Trees", "Debiased ML"]},
    {id: "Regression Trees", imports: ["HTE"]},
    {id: "Debiased ML", imports: ["HTE"]},
    {id: "HTE", imports: ["Cost-Effectiveness"]},
    {id: "Multilevel Modeling", imports: ["Non-Normal Effects", "Location-Scale", "HTE"]},
    {id: "Non-Normal Effects", imports: ["Adaptive Shrinkage"]},
    {id: "Location-Scale", imports: ["Adaptive Shrinkage"]},
    {id: "Adaptive Shrinkage", imports: ["Triple-Goal"]},
    {id: "Triple-Goal", imports: ["Cost-Effectiveness"]},
    {id: "Measurement", imports: ["Classification", "HTE"]},
    {id: "Classification", imports: ["Triple-Goal"]},
    {id: "Cost-Effectiveness", imports: []}
  ];

  const width = 800;
  const radius = width / 2;

  // 1. Build a flat hierarchy (all nodes under one root)
  const root = d3.hierarchy({children: nodesData})
      .each(d => d.data.name = d.data.id);

  const tree = d3.cluster().size([2 * Math.PI, radius - 180]);
  tree(root);

  const nodes = root.leaves();
  const map = new Map(nodes.map(d => [d.data.id, d]));
  const links = [];
  
  nodes.forEach(d => {
    if (d.data.imports) {
      d.data.imports.forEach(i => {
        const target = map.get(i);
        if (target) links.push({source: d, target: target});
      });
    }
  });

  const line = d3.lineRadial()
      .curve(d3.curveBundle.beta(0.85))
      .radius(d => d.y)
      .angle(d => d.x);

  const svg = d3.select("#edge-bundling-container").append("svg")
      .attr("viewBox", [-width / 2, -width / 2, width, width])
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", width)
      .style("max-width", "100%")
      .style("height", "auto")
      .call(d3.zoom().scaleExtent([0.5, 5]).on("zoom", (e) => g.attr("transform", e.transform)));

  const g = svg.append("g");

  const link = g.append("g")
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(links)
    .join("path")
      .attr("class", "link")
      .attr("d", d => line(d.source.path(d.target)));

  const node = g.append("g")
    .selectAll("text")
    .data(nodes)
    .join("text")
      .attr("class", "node")
      .attr("transform", d => `rotate(${d.x * 180 / Math.PI - 90}) translate(${d.y + 8},0)${d.x >= Math.PI ? " rotate(180)" : ""}`)
      .attr("dy", "0.31em")
      .attr("x", d => d.x < Math.PI ? 6 : -6)
      .attr("text-anchor", d => d.x < Math.PI ? "start" : "end")
      .text(d => d.data.id)
      .on("mouseover", mouseover)
      .on("mouseout", mouseout);

  function mouseover(event, d) {
    link.classed("link--connected", l => {
      if (l.source === d) { l.target.connected = true; return true; }
      if (l.target === d) { l.source.connected = true; return true; }
      return false;
    }).filter(l => l.target === d || l.source === d).raise();
    node.classed("node--connected", n => n.connected);
  }

  function mouseout() {
    link.classed("link--connected", false);
    node.classed("node--connected", false);
    nodes.forEach(n => n.connected = false);
  }
});
</script>

```
